label: Sailing HUD
info:
Heads-up display for a phone browser.

  http://enchantee.local/nodered/hud   (through nginx)
  http://enchantee.local:1880/hud      (direct)

Panels: SOG | TWA+AWA | TWS+AWS | HDG+COG. While the motor is
turning (|rpm| > 5, held 10 s) the two wind panels are replaced by
RPM+current and controller+motor temperature.

MQTT values are cached in the flow context by 'Cache HUD values';
the page polls /hud/data twice a second and dims any reading whose
sensor has been quiet for more than 15 s.
